I farm the full 10.1 mu in the usual wheat-maize rotation, so I will plant both crops on the whole area in sequence. I will keep wheat on the cautious, stable side because I am 65, my household labor is only two people, and I have well irrigation, so I would rather aim for a dependable harvest than push the field too hard. For wheat, I will use an improved variety, rotary till the land after maize, give moderate nitrogen with enough phosphorus and some potassium, and plan on two irrigations, mainly around jointing and later grain filling if the field is short of moisture. I will do about two pesticide sprays because in my place I would normally count on weed control plus one “一喷三防” type pass to hold disease, aphids, and dry hot wind risk. I expect solid but not extreme wheat yield.

For summer maize, I will switch to hybrid seed because that is the crop where I would most directly buy yield with genetics. After wheat harvest I will not waste time on heavy tillage; I will direct-seed or use no-tillage to keep the season tight and save labor. I will fertilize maize with less phosphorus than wheat because the local wheat-maize system commonly uses more of the phosphorus on the wheat side and lets maize use some of the residual effect; I will still keep nitrogen and potassium adequate. With well water available, I will plan one irrigation at the key water-sensitive stage and add a second only if drought is obvious, but for this annual plan I will set one normal irrigation. I will also plan two pesticide applications, mainly one early weed or seedling management pass and one later pass if insects or leaf disease build. My yield target is moderate and realistic for a small irrigated farm in southern Hebei, not a demonstration-field target. This is broadly aligned with Ministry of Agriculture guidance for the 华北/黄淮海 winter wheat and summer maize system and Hebei wheat-maize yield references: https://www.moa.gov.cn/xw/zxfb/202309/t20230928_6437567.htm , https://www.moa.gov.cn/govpublic/ZZYGLS/202303/t20230314_6423039.htm , https://www.moa.gov.cn/govpublic/ZZYGLS/202303/t20230303_6422216.htm , https://www.moa.gov.cn/ztzl/wcbgclz/qglb/202409/t20240929_6463653.htm .
